results.title: ‘Iran must pay’: Trump seeks compensation for those killed and wounded in conflicts
results.description: Trump's demand came after he said representatives of the Islamic Republic had sought compensation for damage caused to Iran during a five-month military conflict. Describing the Iranian request as an "interesting idea", Trump said he would make a similar demand of Tehran.
